summary: The Event Horizon is an interactive 3D space exploration website created to make learning about space missions more interesting and engaging. The website allows users to explore different Moon and Mars missions through immersive 3D environments. Users can view spacecraft, landers, rovers and other mission equipment, rotate the camera, zoom in and explore different landing sites. It also includes mission markers, information popups and a Then vs Now section to provide more details about space technology. The website has two main modes: Explore Mode and Story Mode. Explore Mode allows users to freely explore missions, while Story Mode provides a documentary-style experience with narration, subtitles, chapters and camera transitions. The interface follows a dark space-themed design to create an immersive experience. My main goal with this project is to combine 3D technology, education and interactive storytelling into one platform, making space exploration easier and more enjoyable for everyone.
details:
🌌 The Event Horizon

Interactive 3D Space Exploration & Mission Documentary Platform

The Event Horizon is an interactive 3D space exploration website designed to bring the history of space exploration closer to everyone. It allows users to explore Moon and Mars missions through immersive 3D environments, interactive spacecraft models, mission locations and documentary-style storytelling.

Instead of simply reading about space missions, users can explore landing sites, inspect equipment and learn about the technology behind some of humanity's most important space exploration missions.

🚀 Features

🌍 Interactive 3D Exploration

  • Explore different Moon and Mars landing sites.
  • View 3D spacecraft, landers, rovers and mission equipment.
  • Rotate, zoom and navigate around the 3D environment.
  • Explore mission locations through interactive markers.
  • View detailed information about selected equipment.

🔭 Explore Mode

  • Freely explore different space missions.
  • Navigate between Moon and Mars environments.
  • Interact with mission markers and equipment.
  • Discover mission information through interactive popups.
  • Compare historical and modern space technology using the Then vs Now section.

🎬 Story Mode

  • Experience space exploration through documentary-style storytelling.
  • Follow mission chapters with narration and subtitles.
  • Explore mission-specific 3D environments while watching the documentary.
  • Experience camera movements and transitions between missions.
  • Follow the documentary timeline and explore individual mission stories.

🎨 User Interface

  • Dark space-themed interface.
  • Interactive sidebar with mission navigation.
  • Collapsible sidebar for a better viewing experience.
  • Auto-hiding controls and information panels.
  • Responsive interaction support for different screen sizes.
  • Separate Explore Mode and Story Mode access.

🛠️Technologies Used

Technology

HTML5

CSS3

JavaScript (ES6+)

Three.js

WebGL

3D ssets

💡 Project Objectives

The main objectives of The Event Horizon are:

  • Make space exploration more interactive and educational.
  • Help users understand historical Moon and Mars missions.
  • Present spacecraft and scientific equipment in an immersive 3D environment.
  • Encourage curiosity about astronomy and space technology.
  • Combine education, interactive visualization and storytelling.
  • Make complex scientific information easier to understand.

✨ What Makes It Different?

The Event Horizon combines two different experiences into one platform: an interactive 3D space explorer and a documentary-style mission storytelling system.

Users are not limited to watching videos or reading mission descriptions. They can explore the actual mission environments, inspect equipment, interact with markers and follow the history of space exploration through narrated chapters.

The goal is to make users feel more connected to the missions they are learning about.

🎯 Intended Impact

This project aims to make space education more accessible, engaging and enjoyable for students, educators, space enthusiasts and anyone interested in astronomy.

By combining 3D visualization with storytelling, The Event Horizon encourages users to explore, learn and develop an interest in science, engineering and space technology.

🔮 Future Improvements

  • Add more historical and modern space missions.
  • Introduce additional planetary environments.
  • Improve 3D model details and environmental effects.
  • Add more interactive educational content.
  • Enhance documentary camera transitions and storytelling.
  • Improve mobile and touchscreen interactions.
  • Expand the mission database with more scientific information.

👨‍🚀 Project Vision

The Event Horizon is built around one simple idea: space should not just be something we read about; it should be something we can explore.

Through interactive 3D technology, educational content and immersive storytelling, this project aims to bring the experience of space exploration directly into the browser.

Explore beyond Earth. Discover the unknown. Welcome to The Event Horizon. 🌌
